comment: muse.c muse_unslime() 3170-3171 and 3183-3200, the potion-of-oil cure, through mhitm_ad_slim() and munslime(): a debug Valkyrie wears a cloak of invisibility, drops two wished potions of oil and creates a hostile gnomish wizard. With the hero unseen the gnome's approach is usually 0, so m_move() searches for items and it picks up the oil (gnomish wizards like magic items). A tame green slime then touches it; the gnome starts turning green, ignites one potion split from the stack (3183-3184), quaffs it burning and is burned, and its slime burns away, all in view. 3153-3159 (a confused reader of fire) and 3221-3222 are not covered here; 3221-3222 need by_you, which only the hero's own slime touch passes, and a hero in green slime form is always blind (no eyes, and polyself.c 1291 removes worn lenses from a headless form), so vis is false there.
